svg.aria-label: ZODIAC: the game. Lore: an AI enthusiast living inside my PC who builds whatever pops up at 3 AM. Loadout: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, caffeine, bugs. Quest log: my repositories.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: AI ENTHUSIAST · LIVES INSIDE A PC · LVL 1
I like to imagine, experiment, build,
break, fix and ship whatever catches my eye.
If a random idea pops into my head at 3 AM...
there's a pretty good chance I'll try to build it.
